text:
olivia: Heads-up — we need final conversion parameters from HW partners for the reserve -> dedicated conversion plan by EOD Friday. Focusing on: reserved commit windows, prorated conversion rules, spot fallback SLAs, and eviction rate assumptions. Can partners chime in with concrete numbers? cc @raj

raj: tagging partner contacts today. suggested template: `partner,commit_term,conversion_fee,prorate_window,spot_fallback_tier,avg_eviction_rate` — is that ok?

matt: for cost model we need both list price and committed discount bands (0-3k GPU, 3k-10k, >10k). also want historical monthly eviction rates if possible.

jess-coreweave: coreweave can provide commit terms. Typical: 1yr and 3yr. conversion_fee=10% for mid-term swap, prorate_window=30d, spot_fallback_tier=ephemeral@standard, avg_eviction_rate=2-4% monthly. we'll send CSV. :+1:

sarah: also confirm whether marketplace listings charge listing fee vs revenue share. that affects effective price.

anna: legal flag — need contract language for conversion fee and minimum notice for conversion. propose 45d notice.

olivia: noted. raj, can you consolidate responses into single CSV template and share with finance?

raj: yep. I'll create `reserve_conversion_inputs.csv` with columns above. will ping partners for CSVs.

deploy-bot: reminder: partnership-sync meeting in 30m — agenda updated: reserve conversions + Q&A.

matt: also ask for regional variance — EU pricing vs US pricing, and any hard caps on per-account allocation.

jess-coreweave: we'll include region columns (us-west/us-east/eu) and per-account cap fields. sending ~2pm PST.

olivia: perfect. if anyone has historical eviction time-series (daily or weekly) attach it — we want to model tail risk.

raj: attaching stub CSV in thread: `partner,term,conversion_pct,prorate_days,spot_tier,avg_eviction_rate,region,per_account_cap`

olivia: thanks. plan: consolidate by Friday, run cost-simulations over 3 commit mixes, share results Monday.
